latest_decision_overrides.current: Koblins: small goblinoids, troublesome, cheaper fares, large families, mostly first-time cruisers, no extraordinary needs. Mantelids: sophisticated insectoids, quiet cocoons, gruesome molting. Humans. Baelins: beluga-like gelatinous/cartilaginous humanoids, oily/goo trails needing special cleaners, baths and aquatic accommodation. Munkos: four arms, extreme appetite, respectful. Mindos: sentient synthetic-hardware AI species with newly recognized rights; distinct from ordinary helper machines.
latest_decision_overrides.supersedes: Eight prototype morphology names as final canon
